game_title: Fallback: Phone Book Rescue – Cliffside Ledge
game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Cliffside Ledge, a narrow cliff ledge: the mountaineer must hold off crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Phone Book Rescue: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change.
theme: Frost Peaks – Cliffside Ledge: a narrow cliff ledge
core_gameplay_loop: In Cliffside Ledge, repeat each round: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change. Then check contacts and advance.
player_objective: Protect the flag pole from crevasse ghouls in Cliffside Ledge: keep contacts above zero until the 41-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 8 (extended tier): Phone Book Rescue
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 8, Level 8, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
